description: Start on an inline catalog card, information focused, with adjacent posters on both sides. No account mutations or playback. Observe or record the close transition as well as the settled captures; screenshots alone do not prove smooth motion.

steps.name: 02-exit-right
steps.review: First Right focuses actions; second collapses card and selects next poster without opening it.

steps.name: 03-reopen-original
steps.review: Original catalog card opens with information focused.

steps.name: 04-exit-left
steps.review: Left collapses card and selects preceding poster; no overlap remains.
